Payload.$Comment: III keeps player/group scaling ON (unlike I and II, which turn scaling off entirely); only distance escalation is switched off here. The contains pattern reaches a live instance world (named instance-<Name>-<uuid>, so the token sits mid-name), and the trailing '-' inside it is the delimiter the engine puts between the instance name and its id, so each of the three Dungeon of Fear rules matches exactly its own instance. Add "GameplayConfig": ["YourKey"] beside the pattern if your instance authors one - that axis outranks every name pattern and never changes when the instance is rebuilt. PlayerScalingStartRingBlocks is pinned to 0 so the group delta applies from the first block of the instance - the global newcomer ring is measured from world spawn and would otherwise cover the whole dungeon.
